task: Gate Elasticsearch-backed retrieval features (knowledge bases, datasources, code indexing) behind a configurable RETRIEVAL_BACKEND flag across config, API routing, service layer, and workflow utilities

component_scope.label: XXL
component_scope.affected: Config, CustomerConfig, REST API app bootstrap/router registration (main.py), ProviderService, ToolExecutionService, ToolkitService, ToolsInfoService, workflows/utils/utils.py, GoogleDocDatasourceProcessor

technical_risk.label: M
technical_risk.risk_factors: Cross-cutting feature gate touches many independent entry points with a different exception type per layer (404 ExtendedHTTPException in ProviderService, ToolException in ToolExecutionService/ToolkitService, ValueError in workflows/utils.py); a missed guard anywhere would surface as a runtime failure only when RETRIEVAL_BACKEND=none
technical_risk.mitigation: Backward-compatible default (RETRIEVAL_BACKEND=elasticsearch) preserves existing behavior for all current deployments; RETRIEVAL_BACKEND value is validated in Config.finalize_settings; startup warning logged when retrieval is disabled; extensive regression tests added across every touched module including a dedicated boot-branch test file

key_reasoning.reason: The retrieval_available() gate was propagated across 9 distinct components spanning config, REST API bootstrap, four service classes, workflow utilities, and a datasource processor — a shared abstraction applied consistently across multiple subsystems, plus red flags for touching core shared config utilities and multiple agent/tool/workflow paths pushed this to the cap.
20 files changed per diffstat (16+ maps to XXL); 9 source files modified plus 10 test files touched/added to cover the new gating behavior at every layer.

Five distinct layers changed — Config/Infra (RETRIEVAL_BACKEND setting + validation), API (conditional router registration and startup warning in main.py), Service (ProviderService, ToolExecutionService, ToolkitService, ToolsInfoService), Workflow (workflows/utils.py document-tree lookup), and Datasource (GoogleDocDatasourceProcessor) — a cross-cutting feature-flag concern layered onto an existing full-stack surface.

Moderate risk: each layer raises a different exception type for the disabled case, but the change is backward-compatible by default and is backed by comprehensive new/extended tests including a dedicated boot-branch regression test.

red_flags_applied: Touches core shared utilities: config.py and customer_config.py are used throughout the application — bumped Component Scope
Affects multiple workflows or agents: ToolExecutionService, ToolkitService, and workflows/utils.py all gate agent/workflow tool paths — bumped Component Scope (capped at XXL)
